import numpy as np
import torch
from solution import heat, lift, policy_cost
from teacher import stage, stage_cost
from actuator import Actuator
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
w = torch.tensor(0.7, requires_grad=True)
zp = torch.tensor([[0.2,0.6],[0.8,-0.1]])
spec = dict(C=17.,G=1.5,time_scale_min=2.2,time_origin_min=-9.,y_shift_C=18.,y_scale_K=4.,Ta_C=20.)
net = lambda v: w * v[:, :1]**2 + v[:, 1:2]
res = heat(net,zp,spec)
z,p=zp[:, :1],zp[:, 1:2]
expected=17*4*2*w*z/132+1.5*(18+4*(w*z**2+p)-20)-1000*p
torch.testing.assert_close(res,expected)
torch.testing.assert_close(torch.autograd.grad(res.sum(),w)[0], torch.autograd.grad(expected.sum(),w)[0])
assert not zp.requires_grad and heat(net,zp,{}) is None
rng=np.random.default_rng(187)
for horizon in (1,2,6,12):
    for g in (0.,0.4,1.):
        params=dict(a=.87,b=-.31,c=1.2,d=-.7,g=g)
        F,P=lift(params,horizon)
        initial=rng.normal(size=3)
        changes=rng.normal(size=horizon)
        plant=Actuator(params,*initial[:2])
        outputs=[plant.step(u) for u in initial[2]+np.cumsum(changes)]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(F@initial+P@changes,outputs,atol=1e-12)
cfg=dict(N=4,beta=.6,a=.9,b=.25,limit=2.,center=.3,scale=.8,q=.7,r=.1,s=.08,discount=.87)
x=torch.tensor([[-1.1],[.9],[4.]])
ref=torch.tensor([[.5],[-.1],[.7]])
last=torch.tensor([[.2],[.6],[-.2]])
def scalar(k, coupled):
    costs=[]
    for v,r,h in zip(x.flatten().tolist(),ref.flatten().tolist(),last.flatten().tolist()):
        J=0
        for j in range(cfg["N"]):
            vn,u=stage(lambda f:k*f[0]+.22*f[1],v,r,h,cfg)
            if coupled:
                vn+=.07*v-.33*u
            J+=cfg["discount"]**j*stage_cost(vn,r,u,h,cfg)
            v,h=vn,u
        costs.append(J)
    return np.mean(costs)
for coupled in (False,True):
    k=torch.tensor(.42,requires_grad=True)
    fn=lambda f:k*f[:,:1]+.22*f[:,1:2]
    per=lambda f:.07*f[:,:1]-.33*f[:,1:2]
    J=policy_cost(fn,per,x,ref,last,cfg,coupled)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(J.item(),scalar(.42,coupled),rtol=1e-10)
    derivative=(scalar(.420001,coupled)-scalar(.419999,coupled))/2e-6
    np.testing.assert_allclose(torch.autograd.grad(J,k)[0].item(),derivative,rtol=1e-7)
print("thermal units and gradient, lifted predictions, policy values and gradients passed")
'@ | & 'D:\projects\control-agent-harness\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -B -
